# montecarlo_tableau_credentials (Data Source)

Tableau credentials are a password, a personal access token or a connected app Monte Carlo stores for Tableau connections to use. The secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connected_app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the connected app. Null unless the credentials use one.
- `connected_app_secret_id` (String) ID of the connected app's secret. Null unless the credentials use one.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `server_name` (String) URL of the Tableau server, starting with https:// or http://.
- `site_name` (String) Tableau site. Null for the default site.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `token_name` (String) Name of the personal access token. Null unless the credentials use one.
- `username` (String) Tableau user. Null for a personal access token.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate. Verified when left out. Null unless set.
